annotations.title: Base MPP Session-Metered Multi-Source Research Dossier Compiler

description: Compiles a structured JSON research dossier ('key_findings', 'synthesis_quality_score', 'sources_cited') settled via Base EVM Machine Payments Protocol (MPP). Use when generating a strict-JSON cited intelligence brief paid via Base USDC MPP session headers; for running long-form narrative research reports via L402 Lightning, use conduct_deep_research_investigation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'research_topic' ('output_density' defaults to 'concise_5_points'), supports '?demo=true' or MPP (300 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

output_density.description: Granularity of the key_findings array; defaults to 'executive_10_points' when omitted.

query.description: Research topic or technical question to investigate and structure into JSON.

research_topic.description: Alias for query: research topic or technical question to investigate.

name: compile_mpp_research_dossier

key_findings.description: High-density factual bullet strings synthesized from live sources.
